name: Customer or counterparty business inconsistent with technical goods traded
description: Trading or logistics firm with no technical background transacts in items with possible weapons or missile applications.
fp: Distributors do handle technical goods outside their main specialty.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Counter Proliferation Financing (2018)
FATF, Guidance on Proliferation Financing Risk Assessment and Mitigation (2021)
